alt: Two cards compare a product of a value with a copy, which is correct at 3714, and a product of a value with itself, which gives 6190; bars show a sub-problem 2 score of 0.25 on the original library and 5.00 on the fixed one.
caption: The grading library's in-place multiply broke when both operands were the same object, so a correct solution scored 0.25 of 5 points instead of 5.00.
